MathType MTEF parser vendored from https://github.com/uwjiaoxing/mathtype2omml
commit fe5293326ec047bd943de88293add86b8a9050d3 (MIT).

Only `mathtypejx/mtef` is used. Upstream LICENSE, NOTICE and font-map licenses
are retained. No Microsoft Office stylesheet is included or required.
The MathML -> OMML adapter is independently implemented in mathml_import.py.
